candidates.prompt: Use case: illustration-story, one new happy launcher icon for AnkiQuest's Ankilope. Reference 1 is this character's approved frozen launcher headshot, for its face identity, large silhouette, line weight and scarf. Reference 2 is the same character's existing full-body happy master for expression and hues only. Reference 3 is Aki's existing launcher icon for readable size and composition only. Golden tan antelope, light cream brows and muzzle, brown eyes, large brown-edged ears, two ribbed dark brown horns, and a small indigo scarf knot at the lower edge. Show a broad natural open smile, both bright eyes looking directly at the viewer, with the ears lifted. Keep it a balanced straight-on headshot. Remove the ice, snow, shield and flame from the frozen pose. Draw the head and just its scarf, with clean outer lines at 48 dp, matching the painterly style of references 1 and 2. No torso, paws, props, cards, flames, words, letters, sparkles, background or ground shadow. A single transparent RGBA PNG with a centered uncut head and scarf, requested 1254 × 1254 px, generous transparent margins around both ears and horns.
